descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name (זַכּוּר) meaning 'remembered' or 'mindful', borne by several individuals in the OT including a Reubenite spy (Num 13:4), a Simeonite (1 Chr 4:26), Levites (1 Chr 24:27; Neh 10:12), and others. Multilingual renderings are consistent across all occurrences: eng 'Zakkur/Zaccur', spa 'Zacur', hin 'जक्कूर', arb 'زَكُّور', kor '삭굴', swa 'Zakuri'. The conjunction-prefixed form (וְזַכּוּר 'and Zakkur') is purely grammatical and does not alter the referent.
